author: Megan Mueller
title: St. Louis in competition for best botanical garden, zoo - NewsBreak
text:
By Megan Mueller ,
10 hours ago
Note: This video is from April 2025.
ST. LOUIS – It’s no secret to locals that the Gateway City is home to some renowned attractions. The USA TODAY 10Best competition is back for another year, which highlights St. Louis twice in different categories.
The lists of the top contenders for best botanical garden and best zoo are out—and the Missouri Botanical Garden along with the Saint Louis Zoo secured a spot in the nominations.
A brief overview of the Saint Louis Zoo’s nomination highlights the 16,000 animals covering more than 500 species in addition to its “stellar exhibit experience” located at Sea Lion Sound.
Just a few miles away, USA TODAY focuses on the Missouri Botanical Garden’s rich location history, which is now the home of diverse plants, one of the largest Japanese gardens in the continent, and the well-known Climatron.
Missouri AG sues five businesses over ‘unregulated’ gambling machines Judges from USA Today 10Best Readers’ Choice Awards create the list of nominations, but voters get the power to decide on a winner. From best mini golf to plant nursery or dude ranch, there are categories for everything.
Last year, the Saint Louis Zoo came in at #10. In November, the Botanical Garden was #4 in the best botanical garden holiday lights competition.
As of noon Wednesday, the Saint Louis Zoo is sitting at the top of the chart and Missouri Botanical Garden is ranked in the third spot.
Voting ends Sunday, March 8 at 11:59 p.m. Users can cast one vote in each category every day until then. To vote in the USA TODAY 10Best competition, click here .
